statements.impact_statement: REEVALUATE (touched): post-merge scan after PR #44/#48 edited element-view.tsx surfaced the finding. Re-verified against current code: the dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink at element-view.tsx:325 still reads `element.textContent` (unchanged shape; the line only moved because surrounding code grew). The write-time mitigation that justified the prior disposition is still in place — lesson text passes through `sanitizeRichText` (backend/src/config/rich-text.ts:57, built on `sanitize-html`) before storage, called from curriculum-service.ts:1320 and :1413. The nosemgrep marker on line 324 is intact. Re-confirmed not_affected with a fresh 90-day window.

REEVALUATE (touched): post-merge scan after PR #44/#48 edited curriculum-controller.ts surfaced the finding. Re-verified against current code at line 536: `res.send(result)` where `result` is the return value of EditLeaseService.release (edit-lease-service.ts:84-87, returns `{released: boolean}` from `count > 0`) or EditLeaseService.releaseAll (edit-lease-service.ts:90-93, returns `{released: number}` from a Prisma `updateMany` count). Neither payload interpolates any user-supplied string — the shape is a single literal key and a server-computed primitive. Express `res.send` on an object auto-serialises to JSON with Content-Type application/json, which browsers cannot render as HTML. The nosemgrep marker on line 535 is intact. Original disposition re-confirmed with a fresh 90-day window.
